user_question: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College borough boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a spatial boundary for State College borough suitable for intersection with the census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available State College borough boundary dataset. The candidate must cover the State College borough boundary and be usable as a polygon vector dataset.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundary to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the retrieved borough boundary into EPSG:26918 so it is compatible with the supplied census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved borough boundary to EPSG:26918. Do not assign a CRS or infer a source CRS; require the candidate's source CRS to be present in runtime metadata.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Create tract geometries representing the portions of supplied census tracts that intersect State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform polygon intersection between the supplied census tracts and the reprojected State College borough boundary. Preserve the tract identifier attributes needed to identify each intersecting census tract.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject elevation raster to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the supplied elevation raster into EPSG:26918 for zonal statistics with the intersecting tract zones.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the supplied elevation GeoTIFF to EPSG:26918 while preserving the elevation values and producing a GeoTIFF raster.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by intersecting tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the mean elevation within each census-tract zone intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute mean zonal elevation for each intersecting census-tract polygon using the reprojected elevation raster. Retain the tract identifier in the output summary table; ground the runtime identifier field from the observed tract schema.

requirements.scope: Retrieved borough boundary must cover State College borough.
Retrieved borough boundary must be available in a format supported by the projection and overlay workers.
Retrieved borough boundary must have a known source CRS before reprojection.
Census tracts and borough boundary must use compatible CRSs for polygon intersection.
Both polygon inputs must have valid, non-empty geometries for intersection.
Intersected tract zones must retain an observed tract identifier field for the output summary.
Elevation raster and intersecting tract zones must have compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
Zonal statistics output must retain the tract identifier needed to report mean elevation by census tract.
